profile.headline: Software Engineer, Dell EMC | M.S. in Computer Science, Northeastern University
profile.summary:
I am a recent Master’s graduate in Computer Science from Northeastern University. My primary interests are software engineering, system design, distributed systems and artificial intelligence.

Building stuff, especially taking something from its infancy and making it into something mature, stable and fully capable is how I would define an ideal role for me. Making decisions at every step, visualising the project's future, and making something of quality and value, something I can be proud of, are things that would excite me in a position. I love learning new stuff, either as part of my job or on my own. I like taking initiative and am not afraid to express my thoughts and ideas. I am also a firm believer in being language/framework agnostic and believe as an engineer I can pick up and learn any language or framework on the fly to get the job done.

During my Master’s program, I interned with a networking company in California, where I worked as a Java full-stack developer on their lawful intercept management tool.

In my last semester, I worked on a team to build a chatbot used to answer FAQ questions on my university’s website. I helped design the entire backend service for the chatbot. I helped upgrade it from a simple Flask Application to a distributed and containerised application orchestrated with Docker Swarm.

Before I came to the US to pursue my Masters, I received my undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering from India. I then worked for an IT company in India for a little more than 3 years, during which I worked with a pharmaceutical client doing database/server management and helped support their production CRM tool to manage their medical representatives. That is when I decided to pursue my Masters in Computer Science, which led me to where I am now.

positions.description: Assisted faculty, helped with grading and conducting office hours for the Machine Learning Course.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
+ Full Stack Java Developer working with Google Web Template (GWT), Smart GWT, Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB), Hibernate, and MySQL Database for a Lawful Intercept (LI) management tool.
 + Participated in an Agile Development Process including regular standups and bi-weekly sprints.
 + Worked on bug fixes and new feature development using JIRA to track progress.
 + Contributed to bug fixes, enhancements and interfaced with networking team to gather requirements for new features.
 + Contributed ideas and participated in brainstorming sessions with team to come up  with new enhancements to the application.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for the courses "Object Oriented Design', Summer '16 and 'Intensive Foundations in Computer Science', Fall '16.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
+ Managed production databases and ensured sanity of loaded data.
+ Created Automatic Interfaces from to load and process data using PL-SQL procedures and Unix Shell Scripting.
+ Extended technical and functional training to new employees as well as other colleagues in the project.
+ Guided & assisted team members during the release of new application builds (every 5-6 months) into production environment.

projects.title: Building the Northeastern ALIGN Website
projects.description:
+ Building a website for Northeastern ALIGN with other teammates.
+ Contributed to the Machine Learning Team building a chatbot to interact with prospective students and answering enquiries regarding the program and course offerings.
+ Assisted the Database team in initial design decisions, architecture and tooling.
+ Using Google Dialogflow as the dialog engine, backed up by a custom REST api written in Flask, gunicorn(application server).
+ Using Docker as container technology for the back-end and docker swam for container orchestration and High availability.
+ Used Go and Redis to create the caching layer to save commonly requested information by the back-end services.
+ Managing Sprints, Tasks, Active backlog in JIRA and participating in an AGILE engineering process.
+ Interfacing with other teams(front-end, database, deployment) to ensure smooth delivery of the whole project.

projects.title: Classification of CIFAR-100 dataset using Convolutional Neural Network.
projects.description:
Used a Custom Architecture for a Convolutional Neural Network using Keras to classify the CIFAR-100 Dataset.
Achieved a ~45% Accuracy on validation data after 100 epochs.
